---
title: "Combination atlas"
subtitle: "Every candidate of the declared combination grammar, winners and losers"
description: "The combination atlas: every planet x structure candidate tested on the exploration period, its effect and p-value, the corrected threshold, and the survivors carried to confirmation."
---

The combination study enumerates a grammar declared in advance (planet by
sign, house from the Moon, nakshatra group, conjunction or aspect within an
orb, dasha lord; up to three terms) and tests every candidate on the
exploration period. The whole table is published here, not only the
candidates that look interesting, because the losers are what make the
winners believable.

::: {.af-howto}
**How to read this.** Each dot in the volcano plot is one candidate: to the
right it raised the event rate, to the left it lowered it, and higher means a
smaller exploration p-value. The dashed line is the corrected threshold for
the whole family (Benjamini-Yekutieli); only candidates above it (outlined)
survive to the confirmation period. When none passes, the line marks the bar
the smallest p-value would have had to clear. Candidates whose condition is
on too rarely in the exploration period to be tested are listed in the table
(status "untestable") but have no dot. The histogram shows all exploration p-values: if no
candidate carried information they would be spread evenly, like the flat
reference line, and a pile-up near zero is what a real effect, or a leak,
looks like. Filter by planet, structure and status; the table lists every
candidate shown.
:::

```{ojs}
atlas = FileAttachment("../data/atlas.json").json()
L = atlas.lookups || {}
cands = columnsToRows(atlas.columns).map((d) => ({
  ...d,
  structure: L.structure ? L.structure[d.structure] : d.structure,
  status: L.status ? L.status[d.status] : d.status,
  template: L.template ? L.template[d.template] : d.template,
  survivor: !!d.survivor, confirmed: !!d.confirmed,
  logp: d.p > 0 ? -Math.log10(d.p) : null
}))
allPlanets = [...new Set(cands.flatMap((d) => d.planets))].sort()
allStructures = [...new Set(cands.map((d) => d.structure).filter(Boolean))].sort()
allStatuses = [...new Set(cands.map((d) => d.status))].sort()
```

```{ojs}
atlas.fixture ? htl.html`<div class="af-banner" id="atlas-fixture">Illustrative fixture, not results: the combination

  It will show <code>studies/combinations/artifacts/atlas.csv</code> once that file exists.</div>` : htl.html`<span></span>`
```

```{ojs}
  <div class="af-status-item"><h4>${atlas.summary.candidates.toLocaleString()}</h4><span class="af-status-state">Candidates in the declared grammar</span></div>
  <div class="af-status-item"><h4>${atlas.summary.testable.toLocaleString()}</h4><span class="af-status-state">Testable on the exploration period</span></div>
  <div class="af-status-item"><h4>${atlas.summary.explore_nominal_p_lt_alpha} vs ${atlas.summary.expected_nominal_by_chance}</h4>
    <span class="af-status-state">Nominal p below ${atlas.alpha}, observed vs expected by chance alone</span></div>
  <div class="af-status-item"><h4>${atlas.summary.survived_by} survive, ${atlas.summary.confirmed} confirmed</h4>
    <span class="af-status-state">After the family-wide correction; then on the holdout</span></div>
</div>` : htl.html`<span></span>`
```

::: {.af-filters}

```{ojs}
viewof planets = Inputs.checkbox(allPlanets, { label: "Planet", value: allPlanets })
```

```{ojs}
viewof structures = Inputs.select(allStructures, { label: "Structure", multiple: true, value: allStructures, size: Math.min(8, allStructures.length),
  format: (s) => s.replaceAll("_", " ") })
```

```{ojs}
viewof statuses = Inputs.checkbox(allStatuses, { label: "Status", value: allStatuses })
```

```{ojs}
viewof bins = Inputs.radio(new Map([["10 bins", 10], ["20 bins", 20], ["40 bins", 40]]), { label: "Histogram", value: 20 })
```

:::

```{ojs}
shown = cands.filter((d) => d.planets.some((p) => planets.includes(p))
  && (!d.structure || structures.includes(d.structure)) && statuses.includes(d.status))
thresholdLine = atlas.threshold_line ?? atlas.threshold
thresholdLog = thresholdLine > 0 ? -Math.log10(thresholdLine) : null
```

```{ojs}
volcano = {
  const w = Math.max(340, Math.min(width, 1000));
  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width: w, height: 360, marginLeft: 56, marginBottom: 42, style: plotStyle,
    x: { type: "log", label: "Rate ratio, exploration period (log scale)", grid: true, tickFormat: ".2f" },
    y: { label: "-log10 p (exploration)", grid: true, domain: [0, Math.max(thresholdLog ?? 0, d3.max(shown, (d) => d.logp) ?? 1) * 1.08] },
    color: { type: "identity" },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleX([1], { stroke: palette.axis }),
      thresholdLog == null ? null : Plot.ruleY([thresholdLog], { stroke: palette.ink2, strokeDasharray: "5,4" }),
      thresholdLog == null ? null : Plot.text([thresholdLog], { y: (d) => d, frameAnchor: "right", dy: -6, fill: palette.ink2,
        text: () => `${atlas.threshold > 0 ? "corrected threshold" : "no candidate passes; bar for the smallest p"}, p = ${thresholdLine.toExponential(1)}` }),
      Plot.dot(shown.filter((d) => d.effect > 0 && d.logp != null), { x: "effect", y: "logp", r: (d) => (d.survivor ? 6 : 4),
        fill: (d) => (d.survivor ? palette.active : palette.inactive), fillOpacity: (d) => (d.survivor ? 1 : 0.7),
        stroke: (d) => (d.survivor ? palette.ink : palette.surface), strokeWidth: (d) => (d.survivor ? 1.5 : 1),
        title: (d) => `${d.label || d.id}\nrate ratio ${(+d.effect).toFixed(2)}${d.ci_low != null ? ` (${(+d.ci_low).toFixed(2)} to ${(+d.ci_high).toFixed(2)})` : ""}\np ${d.p}${d.p_rw != null ? `, Romano-Wolf p ${d.p_rw}` : ""}, ${d.status}`,
        tip: true })
    ].filter(Boolean)
  });
  return htl.html`<div class="af-chart" id="atlas-volcano">${plot}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
swatchLegend([{ color: palette.active, label: "Survivor (passes the corrected threshold)" }, { color: palette.inactive, label: "Other candidates" }])
```

```{ojs}
pHist = {
  const w = Math.max(340, Math.min(width, 1000));
  const ps = shown.map((d) => d.p).filter((p) => p != null && Number.isFinite(+p));
  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width: w, height: 230, marginLeft: 56, marginBottom: 42, style: plotStyle,
    x: { domain: [0, 1], label: "Exploration p-value" }, y: { label: "Candidates", grid: true },
    marks: [
      Plot.rectY(ps, Plot.binX({ y: "count" }, { x: (d) => +d, domain: [0, 1], thresholds: d3.range(0, 1 + 1e-9, 1 / bins),
        fill: palette.inactive, inset: 1, rx: 2, tip: true })),
      Plot.ruleY([ps.length / bins], { stroke: palette.ink2, strokeDasharray: "5,4" }),
      Plot.text([ps.length / bins], { y: (d) => d, frameAnchor: "right", dy: -6, fill: palette.ink2, text: () => "uniform (no information)" }),
      Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: palette.axis })
    ]
  });
  return htl.html`<div class="af-chart" id="atlas-pvalues">${plot}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
htl.html`<p class="af-caption">${shown.length} of ${cands.length} candidates shown;
  ${shown.filter((d) => d.logp != null).length} tested on the exploration period (one dot each);
  ${shown.filter((d) => d.survivor).length} survivors among them.</p>`
```

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(shown, {
  columns: ["label", "planets", "structure", "effect", "ci_low", "ci_high", "p", "q", "p_rw", "confirm_effect", "status"],
  header: { label: "Candidate", effect: "Rate ratio", ci_low: "CI low", ci_high: "CI high", p: "p (explore)", q: "q (BY)",
    p_rw: "Romano-Wolf p", confirm_effect: "Rate ratio (confirm)" },
  format: { planets: (v) => v.join(", "), effect: (v) => (v == null ? "" : (+v).toFixed(3)),
    ci_low: (v) => (v == null ? "" : (+v).toFixed(3)), ci_high: (v) => (v == null ? "" : (+v).toFixed(3)),
    p: (v) => (v == null ? "" : +v < 0.001 ? (+v).toExponential(1) : (+v).toFixed(3)), q: (v) => (v == null ? "" : (+v).toFixed(3)),
    p_rw: (v) => (v == null ? "" : (+v).toFixed(3)), confirm_effect: (v) => (v == null ? "" : (+v).toFixed(3)) },
  sort: "p", rows: 16
})
```
